name: Add to cart
summary: Buy block on the product page: stock, quantity, "Add to cart" button and delivery time.
use: Product page, below the Variant picker.
avoid: Product cards: one small button is enough there.
anatomy: Quantity stepper, Accent button (fills the space), optional wishlist.
Delivery time with a truck icon.
figmaProps: Default, Low stock, Out of stock
Out of stock: quantity and button off, delivery time hidden.
reactProps: Default 'accent', so the buy action stands out from the brand color.
behaviour: After adding, the Mini cart usually opens (see Examples).
a11y: Announce that the item was added (Mini cart or a status message), not only visually.
content: Button: "Add to cart". Sold out: "Sold out".
dont: A disabled button with no explanation why.
open: "Email me when it is back in stock" does not exist yet.
